arguments.cmd:
cd /tmp/rotonly && python3 -c "
src = open('model.scad').read()
old = '[[\"disc\"], [0, 1, 0]]'
new = '[[\"disc\"], [0, 0, -1]]'
assert src.count(old)==1
open('model.scad','w').write(src.replace(old,new))
print('ok')
"
timeout 120 cadcheck assembly --out-dir /tmp/rotonly/aout model.scad 2>&1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('ok:',d['ok']); print('G3:',str(d['problems']['G3'])[:800]); print('G4:',str(d['problems']['G4'])[:2500])"
